skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding and recognizing basic knowledge about corporate reengineering
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, nature, context, requirements, cases, stages, principles, conditions, and contents of corporate reengineering.
Demonstrate ability to work independently, with discipline, in groups, communicate effectively, present ideas, and solve problems creatively.
Show capability to conduct independent research, accumulate and enhance professional knowledge, adapt to various working environments, and take responsibility for personal development.
Understand professional ethics, social responsibility, and civic duty.
